content: The HTML Standard and MDN describe EventSource as a persistent one-way HTTP stream. The browser fires error on connection failure; by default a closed connection is restarted, while close() terminates it. SSE records are UTF-8, separated by blank lines, and comment lines can serve as keepalives; retry controls reconnect delay and id/Last-Event-ID can support resume. Server code should detect client disconnects and stop writing. Therefore a browser reconnect is not proof that a round was lost, but reconnection without round-id/state reconciliation can duplicate or regress UI state; keepalives only cover idle transport boundaries that observe bytes, not a dead/stuck TCP path.
